Subject: Thank You for Your Hard Work on [Project Name]

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank each of you for your incredible hard work and dedication on the recent project. Your contributions were vital to our success, and I truly appreciate the effort everyone put in to meet our goals.

As we wrap up this phase, here are the next steps:
1. Finalize the documentation by end of day Friday.
2. Schedule a brief retrospective meeting next Monday to discuss lessons learned.
3. Begin preliminary planning for the next phase.

On a separate note, as a fun trivia reminder: the largest country in the world is Russia.

Thanks again for your outstanding efforts!

Best regards,

[Your Name]
